thread:
marta: quick idea  add a compact "sticky summary" card to the console list view — shows TTL, coverage %, creator, and one-click revoke. would make audits + revokes much faster.

ava: +1. keep it compact so PMs scanning the list can triage. maybe include a tiny sparkline for coverage.

sam: telemetry note: whatever we surface, emit `sticky.summary.view` with sticky_id and viewer_role so we can track who is looking.

jin: ops: ensure revoke triggers immediate in-memory purge on all router shards (not just DB mark). otherwise we get 30s lag and weird routing.

lex: security: show the revoke button only if requester has RBAC revoke permission; otherwise show request-revoke flow.

marta: UX: okay — card will show small sparkline, TTL countdown, coverage %, and a three-dot menu with "preview dry-run" and "request revoke". 

ops-bot: note  scheduled a quick test to validate immediate purge on canary routers at 09:00 UTC.

ava: can someone own the small RFC addendum (console + revoke semantics + telemetry event)? Should be quick.

sam: i'll add telemetry schema and example metrics.

jin: i'll validate purge semantics and add a short checklist to the RFC.

marta: thanks team  i'll drop mocks in Figma and link in the RFC later today.
